name: skill-regression-root-cause
title: 定位候选Skill无增益与回归根因
description: 只读对比真实base/candidate执行轨迹、工具查询、产物与官方评分点，定位train001无提升和train004丢2分的首个因果差异，并给出简历安全结论。
creator: kelong.zx
notes: Read-only causal audit: candidate Skill was supplied but remained a generic checklist. train001 changed one order without rescuing any all-or-nothing scoring group; train004 had complete inventory data but chose mixed_actions for two multi-action order rollups, losing SP7's two points. Single unseeded run does not establish Skill causality.
